title: DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository: UC model files go through WorkspaceClient().files with a single streamed download; list_artifacts returns [] for a file or missing path
answers: Listing a Unity Catalog model version's artifacts raises NotFound when the path is a single file; how is that handled?
Why are UC model downloads single-stream with no presigned URL, and where is that decided?
Where is the Databricks workspace client built for model artifact I/O on serverless or SEG compute?
How do I change the chunk size used when downloading Unity Catalog model files?
body:
Path: The Files-API artifact repo for UC model versions stored under /Models/<catalog>/<schema>/<model>/<version>. It handles list_artifacts, log_artifact and upload (_upload_to_cloud), and download (_download_from_cloud) for both model load and model register. Chokepoint: mlflow/store/artifact/databricks_sdk_models_artifact_repo.py:DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository.
Rule: The workspace client comes from _get_databricks_workspace_client(registry_uri): it uses host and token from get_databricks_host_creds when both are present, otherwise default WorkspaceClient() auth. Downloads stream resp.contents in MLFLOW_MULTIPART_DOWNLOAD_CHUNK_SIZE chunks. CloudArtifactRepository._download_file forces this single-stream branch for this class by class-name check, since presigned-URL parallel download does not apply. list_artifacts first calls _is_dir (files.get_directory_metadata, NotFound means False) and returns [] for a file or missing directory.
Symptom: On serverless or SEG compute a bare WorkspaceClient() failed with 'default auth: cannot configure default credentials' on Spark executors. Listing a path that was a file or did not exist was not reported as an empty result.
Constraints: Used only when MLFLOW_USE_DATABRICKS_SDK_MODEL_ARTIFACTS_REPO_FOR_UC is enabled. Upload always passes overwrite=True. databricks.sdk and its NotFound class are imported lazily inside the methods, so the module imports without them being used.
applies: Internals of UC model artifact transfer through the Databricks Files API (list, upload, download of model version files); not general cloud artifact repos.
says: Loading registered models fails on serverless clusters with credential errors on worker nodes.
Model artifact browser shows an empty result instead of crashing on single files.
Catalog model registration and loading fail when run across distributed cluster executors.
Provide an option to adjust chunk size for downloading large model artifacts.
search: DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository manages Unity Catalog model artifacts under /Models/<catalog>/<schema>/<model>/<version> using WorkspaceClient().files, resolving credentials via _get_databricks_workspace_client(registry_uri) using get_databricks_host_creds before falling back to default WorkspaceClient() auth. Downloads are forced to single-stream chunks of MLFLOW_MULTIPART_DOWNLOAD_CHUNK_SIZE by a class-name check in CloudArtifactRepository._download_file because presigned URLs do not apply, while uploads always pass overwrite=True. Directory listings call _is_dir via get_directory_metadata, catching NotFound to return [] for a file or missing directory rather than raising. This repo applies only when MLFLOW_USE_DATABRICKS_SDK_MODEL_ARTIFACTS_REPO_FOR_UC is enabled, preventing default credential failures on serverless or SEG Spark executors, and lazily imports databricks.sdk and NotFound.
